sections.text: Redesigning without an audit is guessing. *An audit tells you what to fix first*, and what to leave alone.
prose: Most sites and products don't lose customers because of one big problem. They lose them through a dozen small frictions: a vague promise, a confusing step, a missing proof, a form that asks too much. Each one costs a little; together they cost a lot.
Our audit finds them, explains why they hurt, and ranks them so your next hour of work goes where it brings the most revenue.

items.p: Is it clear in a few seconds what you sell, to whom and why you? We check the value proposition, headlines and calls to action.
Navigation, key paths and forms, reviewed against usability best practices and real user behavior.
Every step from first visit to inquiry, purchase or sign-up, and where people drop off.
Testimonials, case studies, guarantees and reassurance at the moments visitors hesitate.
How the pages read, load and work on a phone, where most visits happen.
When you give us access, your analytics and session recordings to confirm what the review suggests.

steps.p: A short call to understand your goals, your audience and the pages or product to review.
steps.out: Outcome: an agreed scope and fixed price.

steps.p: We review the experience, the copy and, when available, your data.
We rank each fix by impact and effort and show it on annotated screens.
We walk you through the findings and answer your team's questions.
steps.out: Deliverable: a debrief call and clear next steps.

sections.h2: Frequently asked questions about the *UX/CRO audit*
Ready to find out what *holds back your conversions?*
sections.p: Tell us which site, page or product to review. We'll confirm the scope and the fixed price.

a: A UX/CRO audit is an expert review of a website, landing page or digital product that identifies what prevents visitors from becoming customers. UX covers how easy and clear the experience is; CRO (conversion rate optimization) covers how well it leads people to act. The result is a prioritized list of fixes.

faq.q: How much does the audit cost?
a: [PRICE TO CONFIRM]. The price is fixed and confirmed before we start, based on the size of the site or product.

faq.q: What do I receive at the end?
a: A prioritized action plan with annotated screens, and a debrief call where we walk your team through the findings and answer questions.
You can implement them yourselves with the action plan, or have us do it, as a landing page or website project, a product design project, or an ongoing fractional engagement.

faq.q: Can you audit a SaaS product or a mobile app?
a: Yes. We audit websites, landing pages and sales funnels, as well as SaaS products and mobile apps, including onboarding, activation and pricing pages.
